title: Hruday boundary decay of the AM2 creation coefficients for the named constructions
selection_reason: Deliberation loop 1: the AM2 contraction survives in a weighted norm (and extends to a complex coupling disc), so a change of the box boundary reaches supports meeting the cover only through chains of stars, each costing the ball ratio 37888|tau|. This is the first of two steps towards whole-sequence convergence of the named constructions (roadmap goals 1 and 3); the reduced density is BB1.
model: Zero-selected patterned family (AM2/AQ1): SU(2) Kogut-Susskind form on Z^3 at fixed spacing, coarse 24-link factors, selected triple exactly (0,0,0), Haar product reference, 21 omitted faces per anchor with normalized coefficient -(tau/3) per face (delta=alpha/8), both signs |tau|<=10^-8; the AM2 creation expansion with J<=28|tau|, R=1/64, G(t)=16e^{8t}(1+10t); construction families F1 (AQ1 centered whole-star boxes Lambda_N=[-N,N]^3 in coarse coordinates) and F2 (I1 section 6 all-contained-face boxes with padding on the same Lambda_N), N>=2; cover R={0,e_z}.

parameters.metric: coarse l-infinity metric on factor sites; every whole star phi_b has support b+S with l-infinity diameter d_X=1 (to be verified by enumeration; an l1 reading with diameter 2 is a labelled alternative, never mixed)
parameters.weights: forward: anchored norm ||c||_{a,w}=max_u sum_{I containing u} w^{n(I)} ||c_I|| with n(I) the least number of connected stars covering I (equivalently the coarse l-infinity diameter weight), loss paid once per interaction; difference weight measured by distance from the boundary source, growing towards R's complement, never from R; reverse: complex coupling z with |z|<=tau_star, tau_star=1/37888 in the J=28|z| parametrization

headline.tier: exact_first_order (AV1-type exact first-order coefficients plus self-consistent remainder)

rate_floor.note: q_min = 37888|tau| at the cap; the analytic route's natural pair (preview K=(1/32)/(1-q))

rate_constant_pair.crude_tier_reported: crude_majorant (preview K about 2.9e-4 at q=1/64), reported, not a target

comparisons: F1 on Lambda_N versus F1 on Lambda_{N+1}
F2 on Lambda_N versus F2 on Lambda_{N+1}
F1 versus F2 on the same Lambda_N (exponent N-1)
any two boxes of the named constructions containing Lambda_N (general volumes via the union)
parameters.cutoff: on-site cutoff L>=24 uniform, then removed as in AV1 (cutoff-uniform constants)

required: 1. Name the metric, the weights, the loss per interaction and the difference weight exactly as in parameters; prove (itemized, not by analogy) that the AM2 multilinear estimate HNM-AM2.5 survives in the weighted anchored norm with an explicit loss factor per interaction, and that the ball self-map and Lipschitz inequalities hold in that norm at J=28|tau|, |tau|<=10^-8 for every weight up to the stated maximum (forward), or that the AM2 contraction holds for complex couplings |z|<=tau_star with the coefficient map analytic in z (reverse).

2. Prove the order-versus-distance lemma: a creation coefficient on a support meeting R depends on an interaction term whose support lies at coarse distance at least d from R only at order at least ceil(d/diam) in the coupling, with the diameter convention named; enumerate the stars and supports on Lambda_2 and Lambda_3 to confirm the diameter and the incidence, and give an all-size argument.

3. Identify exactly the boundary source for each comparison in parameters.comparisons: the interaction terms present in one box and not the other (for F1 versus F2 on the same box: the 28N(5N+1) extra faces, regrouped at their anchors and charged face by face exactly once) and their exact coarse distance from R (derived by enumeration plus an all-size argument).

4. Prove the coefficient-difference bound sum_{I containing u, I meeting R} ||c_I^{box1}-c_I^{box2}|| <= K q^(N-1) for u in R with the frozen headline pair (q=1/64, K<=1/2000000 at the exact first-order tier) and the floor pair (q=148/390625, K<=1/16), both signs of tau, for every comparison; report the crude-majorant tier separately; never use the global Lipschitz constant 2J_0G'(R) as a decay factor.

5. State plainly that coefficient decay is not decay of the reduced density on R (the normalization couples all supports; that is BB1), and export the gate fields; quote the mandatory sentence template once as one unbroken span.

6. Declare and check the tau -> tau/100 scaling of each headline constant against its bracket in preregistration.scaling_brackets_per_constant; exact finite fixtures for the traps (a weight growing from R that fails; a global Lipschitz bound that does not decay; a per-creation loss charge that fails); every control executed as a damaging mutation.
claim_exclusions: decay of the reduced density or of any state (BB1/BB2)
uniqueness of every infinite-volume ground state
any estimate uniform in the lattice spacing a
statements about untruncated creation coefficients beyond the AM2 cutoff-removal chain
direction_note: Forward: weighted anchored norm with loss per interaction and a boundary-distance difference weight. Reverse: complex-coupling analyticity of the AM2 fixed point on |z|<=tau_star plus the order-versus-distance count and Cauchy's estimate. The routes share the AM2 majorant but differ in the decay mechanism; independence is limited to route, enumeration and code.

acceptance.accepted_within_scope: Both routes prove the coefficient-difference bound for every comparison with the frozen pairs met (margin at least 2) at both signs.
acceptance.limited: Only the floor pair, only one comparison, or only the crude tier is proved; or the diameter convention fails and only the l1 alternative closes.
acceptance.insufficient: The weighted contraction fails at the cap, or the bound is derived from the global Lipschitz constant.

preregistration.error_terms_rule: an entry may be not_applicable only with a stated reason

target.quantity: K at q=1/64 (exact first-order tier) and K at q=148/390625
target.note: blind discriminating threshold for a new estimate; previews from deliberation (2.2004e-7 and about 0.0313) give margins of about 2.27 and 2

preregistration.mandatory_sentence_template: For the zero-selected patterned family at the same coupling |tau|<=10^-8, and for the named construction families F1 (centered whole-star boxes) and F2 (all-contained-face boxes with padding) on centered coarse cubes, the AM2 creation coefficients on supports meeting the cover R differ between two boxes of the named constructions by at most K q^(N-1) in the anchored norm, where N is the smaller box size; this is decay of the coefficients of the named constructions at a rate in N, not decay of the reduced density, not uniqueness of any ground state, and not a statement uniform in the lattice spacing a.
forbidden_phrasings: uniqueness of the infinite-volume ground state
